Track Written, Composed, Produced and Performed by Ritviz. Featuring Seedhe Maut.
To letting go off your inhibitions, enabling your dreams, Chalo Chalein is all about dancing to the rhythm of your heart and Doing what really moves you!
It was fun collaborating with these phenomenal artists! A huge Shout out to these lovely dancers:
Ayushi Amrute - Wacking
Jahanvi Sheriff - Dancehall
Chinmay Khedekar - Bolly Hop
Eden Pereira - Contemporary
Tapas Boro - Contemporary
